note: Hosting/Cloud Provider Attribution Reference — v2 strict-superset expansion. HCP-001..003 (AWS/Azure/Google Cloud) byte-identical from v1.0. Adds 13 documentary-verified providers HCP-004..016 (CDN/edge, website-builders, managed-hosting) surfaced by RUN-CLOUDHOST-001. ASN_EXACT primary (RIR-registered, Cymru-verified) + IP_RANGE_CONTAINMENT where the provider publishes ranges. Attribution-only; no scoring/ranking/reputation. Hand-authored from documentary sources.
backward_compatibility: Strict superset of v1.0: HCP-001..003 byte-identical (same provider_id/name/class/asns/ip_ranges); no v1 mapping altered or removed; additive only. Every IP mapped under v1 maps to the same provider_id under v2.
cdn_masking_note: cdn_edge providers (Cloudflare/Akamai/Fastly/Imperva) front the origin and MASK the true hosting provider. Attribution records the observable EDGE operator, never the masked origin (HPR-001; backend never inferred). Therefore cloud-hosting-origin concentration computed from this dataset is a LOWER BOUND (email gateway-masking analogue).

freeze.release_authority: Founder / Governance Architect (Founder Dataset Freeze Review 2026-06-23)
freeze.documentary_verification: All 13 new providers' ASNs verified 2026-06-23 via Team Cymru AS-name (RIR-registered org). Published IP-range files fetched over HTTPS for Cloudflare (cloudflare.com/ips-v4, 15 CIDRs — all included), Fastly (api.fastly.com/public-ip-list, representative subset), DigitalOcean (digitalocean.com/geo/google.csv, representative subset). ASN_EXACT is the primary key for all 13; IP_RANGE_CONTAINMENT added where published.
freeze.revalidation_at_freeze: PASS — validate-seed-v2.js 19/19 (schema, provider_id/ASN uniqueness, valid CIDRs, no cross-provider overlap, provenance, HCP-001..003 byte-identical, strict superset, attribution re-checks).
freeze.immutability: Immutable per HPR-001 §8.1 from this freeze. Supersedes v1.0 as the dataset for new runs; v1.0 retained immutable for RUN-CLOUDHOST-001 reproducibility. Expansion only via strict-superset successor (HPR-DATA-003).
freeze.scope_at_freeze: 16 providers HCP-001..016. cdn_edge entries (Cloudflare/Akamai/Fastly/Imperva) front origins and MASK the true host -> cloud-hosting-origin concentration is a LOWER BOUND (email gateway-masking analogue; origin never inferred). ASN sets are observed+obvious-major per provider; Fastly/DigitalOcean ranges representative (Cloudflare complete) -- breadth, not correctness.

entries.evidence_source: Published range file https://ip-ranges.amazonaws.com/ip-ranges.json (createDate 2026-06-22-22-27-05, syncToken 1782167225 — AWS system-of-record, authoritative). ASNs AS16509 (AMAZON-02) + AS14618 (AMAZON-AES), RIR-registered (ARIN). Verified 2026-06-23.

Published range file 'Azure IP Ranges and Service Tags – Public Cloud' (Microsoft Download Center id=56519 → ServiceTags_Public_20260615.json, changeNumber 405, cloud=Public; AzureCloud service tag). ASN AS8075 (MICROSOFT-CORP-MSN-AS-BLOCK), RIR-registered (ARIN). IP_RANGE_CONTAINMENT is the precise primary key (AzureCloud); AS8075 corroborates (Microsoft-operated network). Verified 2026-06-23.

Published range file https://www.gstatic.com/ipranges/cloud.json (creationTime 2026-06-23T07:09:24, syncToken 1782223764283 — GCP-specific, the correct file for cloud attribution). ASN AS396982 (GOOGLE-CLOUD-PLATFORM), RIR-registered. NOTE: AS15169 (GOOGLE, broader — carries consumer Search/Gmail/YouTube) is DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED as an over-broad shared key (HPR-001 H-E1 / E3-analogue): it would conflate consumer-Google-served endpoints with Google Cloud hosting. cloud.json + AS396982 are the GCP-specific keys. Verified 2026-06-23.
